t: Jiu-Jitsu of the Keyboard: Crafting Flow, Taming AI for the Articulate Ape
s: This article explores the 'Jiu-Jitsu' methodology for maintaining flow-state by optimizing tool ergonomics and disciplined AI integration. It contrasts 'Bouba' (disruptive) and 'Kiki' (flow-enhancing) interfaces, advocating for a 'No-Gooey' approach exemplified by the tactile 'whack-a-mole' Pomodoro timer versus GUI-driven mouse interactions, and AI as a 'magic mirror' for craftsmen.
sub: Tactile Pomodoro timer ('whack-a-mole') vs. GUI mouse interruption
